verdict.rationale: Deep crawling is a fair question for a browser-automation and web-data platform, but the evidence documents no crawl feature, breadth-first strategy, or maximum page limit. It shows only single-URL fetching, web search, and concurrent browser sessions a developer could use to build a crawler, which are building blocks rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can run a deep crawl using a breadth-first strategy with a configurable maximum page limit
